title: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1 - Ethics & Professional Responsibilities - Duty of Civility
exam: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1
subject: Ethics & Professional Responsibilities

questions.q: During a contentious cross-examination at the WSIB, opposing counsel aggressively insults the paralegal's intelligence on the record. What is the paralegal's appropriate response?
options: Insult the opposing counsel in return to aggressively defend their reputation.
Maintain a courteous and civil demeanor, address objections to the adjudicator, and avoid personal retaliation.
Walk out of the hearing room immediately in protest.
Demand the client verbally attack the opposing counsel.
questions.explain: Rule 2.01 mandates civility. A paralegal must be courteous, civil, and act in good faith with all persons with whom the paralegal has dealings in the course of their practice. A paralegal must avoid sharp practice and not stoop to the level of opposing counsel's unprofessional behavior.
